bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; appropriating money for prosecutorial and law enforcement training.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION.

$125,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $125,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of public safety for a grant to the Minnesota County Attorneys Association to be used for prosecutorial and law enforcement training, including trial school training and train-the-trainer courses. $125,000 for this activity is added to the base in fiscal year 2028 and thereafter.
additions: $125,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $125,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of public safety for a grant to the Minnesota County Attorneys Association to be used for prosecutorial and law enforcement training, including trial school training and train-the-trainer courses. $125,000 for this activity is added to the base in fiscal year 2028 and thereafter.
